param: β Transmission rate, part of the force of infection λ(t). Inferred via re-parameterization in the paper.
σ Rate of becoming infectious (progression through E1 and E2). Corresponds to an average latent period dL = 2/σ.
γ Rate of recovery (progression through I1 and I2). Corresponds to an average infectious period dI = 2/γ.
π Initial susceptibility, the proportion of the population that is initially susceptible to infection.
λ₀ Initial infection rate, used for model initialization in the inference framework.
ψ Exponential Growth Rate (EGR), used for re-parameterization of the model for inference.
η Over-dispersion parameter for the Negative Binomial observational model.
p_ICU Probability of ICU admission given infection, a measure of severity.
µ_ICU|E Mean time from infection to ICU admission (observational model parameter).
σ²_ICU|E Variance of time from infection to ICU admission (observational model parameter).
N₂₀₁₂⸝₁₃ Total population size for the 2012/2013 season.
N₂₀₁₃⸝₁₄ Total population size for the 2013/2014 season.
N₂₀₁₄⸝₁₅ Total population size for the 2014/2015 season.
